name: @fossil-lang/codemirror-fossil
description: The fossil language layer for CodeMirror 6: highlighting from the compiler's own lexer (tokenize + tokenKinds) and diagnostics from its checker (check → @codemirror/lint). Extensions only — it composes into any editor rather than being one.
//peers: @codemirror/lint is NOT optional and the others are not either — this package IS the wiring between them and fossil, so a consumer that has none of them has no use for it. @fossil-lang/wasm is a peer rather than a dependency because the host owns when the module is instantiated (initFossilWasm takes the .wasm URL) and two copies of that glue is the duplication packages/wasm's client.ts split exists to prevent.
